review.method: Env names read by claude-agent-sdk 0.3.319 were extracted from the SDK .mjs files and the claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64-musl binary (process.env.X, Bun.env.X, process.env["X"], plus literal Node and Bun runtime control names grepped from the binary). Harness and runtime controls outside the denied prefixes were classified and denied. Allowed names that the harness also reads and that are application configuration are recorded under overlaps where they matter; the remaining allowed names were not individually classified. Codex 0.167.0 gets user variables only per command; its app-server environment is worker-owned.

overlaps.name: AWS_REGION
overlaps.reason: application configuration; the Claude CLI reads it only after a CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* provider selector, which the CLAUDE_ prefix denies

overlaps.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AWS_PROFILE
overlaps.reason: application configuration; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: CLOUD_ML_REGION
overlaps.reason: read by the CLI only with the Vertex selector, which is denied by the CLAUDE_ prefix

overlaps.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
overlaps.reason: provider selector; user variables cannot change the provider the worker selects

overlaps.name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: request timeout of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: thinking budget of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: tool output bound of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
overlaps.reason: feature switch read by the Claude CLI; denied by the DISABLE_ prefix

overlaps.name: HTTPS_PROXY
overlaps.reason: network routing of the harness process; denied by the _PROXY suffix

overlaps.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
overlaps.reason: provider credential selection for Codex; denied by the OPENAI_ prefix

overlaps.name: NO_COLOR
overlaps.reason: read by commands the agent runs; the app-server environment never receives user variables

overlaps.name: NODE_ENV
overlaps.reason: application configuration read by the Node runtime of the Claude CLI and by most build tools; it does not select a provider or credential, so it stays allowed

overlaps.name: DEBUG
overlaps.reason: application logging switch also read by the Claude CLI for its debug output; does not select a provider or credential

overlaps.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
overlaps.reason: application telemetry configuration; the CLI exporter only runs after CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY, which the CLAUDE_ prefix denies

overlaps.name: CI
overlaps.reason: read by build tools and by the CLI to detect automation; no effect on provider or authentication

overlaps.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
overlaps.reason: application telemetry credential; the CLI exporter only runs after CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY, which the CLAUDE_ prefix denies

overlaps.name: TZ
overlaps.reason: time zone read by the runtime and by commands; affects timestamps only, not provider, credential or routing

overlaps.name: TERM
overlaps.reason: terminal type read by the CLI and by commands; affects output formatting only

overlaps.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
overlaps.reason: Bedrock bearer token; inert without the denied CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK selector, and builds may need it

overlaps.name: BUN_CONFIG_REGISTRY
overlaps.reason: the BUN_ prefix also denies Bun package-manager settings (BUN_CONFIG_REGISTRY, BUN_AUTH_TOKEN): Bun is the harness runtime; Bun's installer also honours NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY / NPM_CONFIG_TOKEN, which stay allowed

overlaps.name: GRPC_DEFAULT_SSL_ROOTS_FILE_PATH
overlaps.reason: TLS root file for gRPC read by the pinned Claude CLI binary: network wiring of the harness process
